messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the Food Safety Committee space. We will use this channel to coordinate our FSMA guidance reviews and upcoming webinar topics.

messages.author: lars.sorensen.100195@mossgatecheeseco.example
messages.text: Glad to be here. I can help pull together the initial draft notes on environmental pathogen monitoring if that works for the group.

messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: That would be fantastic, Cesar. Let's make that our main agenda item for the end of the month.

messages.author: obi.kone.100216@birchmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: We are seeing more questions from smaller producers about sanitation log templates. Might be worth adding to the next webinar.

messages.author: lars.sorensen.100195@mossgatecheeseco.example
messages.text: Good catch, Yun. I have some clean-in-place verification checklists we could adapt into standard templates for the membership.

messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: The annual conference prep is ramping up. Please let me know if any of you have final topics for the food safety roundtable sessions.

messages.author: ruth.holloway.101191@ostergaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: We would love to cover export documentation and testing requirements if there is an open slot.

messages.author: salome.faucher.100400@ottermerecheesemaking.example
messages.text: How are everyone's member facilities handling temperature logging during the shift to remote oversight and reduced staffing?

messages.author: obi.kone.100216@birchmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: Most are relying on automated continuous monitors with remote alerts, Hannah. We can share a quick overview of what works best.

messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: In-person committee meetings resume next month. We need to finalize our review schedule for the updated hazard analysis guidelines.

messages.author: lars.sorensen.100195@mossgatecheeseco.example
messages.text: I will review the revised sanitation control sections and bring feedback to the table.

messages.author: nathan.bramley.101671@novacekfarmsteadcreamery.example
messages.text: Has ICF staff circulated the latest member feedback digest yet? I wanted to check the responses on the sanitation workshop.

messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: Yes, James, the summary went out yesterday morning along with the meeting notes.

messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: We need to turn our focus to the raw-milk aging rule modernization and traceability updates on our action list.

messages.author: lars.sorensen.100195@mossgatecheeseco.example
messages.text: I can start outlining the changes needed for our member guidance document this week.

messages.author: ruth.holloway.101191@ostergaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: Let me know if you need any international comparisons included in that draft, Gwen.

messages.author: gwen.whitfield.000108@quillpost.example
messages.text: Thanks, Linda. That international perspective will be essential for the final committee recommendations.

messages.author: lars.sorensen.100195@mossgatecheeseco.example
messages.text: The guidance revision draft is nearly complete. I will post it here for final review before our August deadline.
